rationale: Adopt the 2019-2020 USDA assignment (7204 Fruit drinks -> PDI group ssb). Principle: the later USDA classification is treated as the best available public representation of the food, because USDA's revision incorporates updated product information -- here, that commercial acai 'blends' are sweetened beverages rather than 100% juice. LIMITATION: the NHANES 2017-March 2020 pre-pandemic public file omits the survey-cycle identifier (disclosure control), so it is not possible to apply each FNDDS release to the records it was contemporaneous with. A single assignment per food code is therefore forced, and this rule is a documented compromise rather than a resolution. Both candidate PDI groups (fruit_juices, ssb) are unhealthy-plant groups, so the direction of the PDI contribution is unchanged. Affects 7 participants (~0.1%).

rationale: Adopt the 2019-2020 USDA assignment (3406 Egg rolls/dumplings/sushi -> not WWEIA-derived; decomposed by FPED). Same principle: the later USDA classification is the best available public representation. Practical consequence is that the item is decomposed into its refined-grain, legume and added-sugar components rather than assigned wholesale to sweets_desserts, which better represents a steamed bean-paste bun. LIMITATION: as above, the absence of a survey-cycle identifier in the pre-pandemic file prevents cycle-contemporaneous assignment and forces one classification per food code. Affects 9 participants (~0.1%).
